note: Frozen once shipped. `shipped` is the m0saic line each template folder shipped at (the conventions audit's shippedAt, compared as semver — never a date); `release` is the line of the mint that wrote this file, and a re-mint keeps every folder's line. A hashed file never changes again — comments included (byte hashes; render-time assets too). A fix is a new vN+1 folder; deprecate the old one from the pack barrel (`deprecated: { replacement }`) and point it at the new id. Minted from HEAD with `node tools/check-freeze.mjs --update --tag <m0saic line>` at a release, by the founder. See AGENTS.md.
